title: Blood glucose outside the normal range on repeat readings
reasonTemplate: Your last 2 blood-glucose readings were both outside the 70–180 mg/dL range (between {glucose_high.value:.0f} and {glucose_low.value:.0f} mg/dL; your normal {glucose_low.baseline:.0f}).
disclaimer: Illustrative rule for the prototype; not a clinical threshold. Needs two readings in a row, like the other Attention rules; a single very low reading is covered by MET-GLUCOSE-LOW.
